title: Home says whether work is moving, what broke and what changed since your last visit
description: A real browser on the built dashboard, its last visit stored by a real control plane: the status snapshot is seeded with a release check wedged 28 hours and half the Builder accounts held. At 1280 and 390 px Home's first line reads Slowed with Builders working of allowed, test machines ready of configured, last live and merges an hour today, and one card each for the release check and the held accounts names what broke, the impact, what the team does and one button. A second visit after one merge and one Lead decision counts exactly that merge and that decision, offers Ask why and Do it differently, and shows what is being built now and the box that tells the Lead.

steps.name: status line, incident cards and since you last looked on Home
